reason: Calendar-specific authored geometry, source filters, agenda and responsive rules remain a single presentation stylesheet. The new compact header/disclosure owns no data or routing policy; ModuleBreadcrumb remains the navigation owner. No other module geometry changes.

Owns only Bill Tracker screen composition and local table/board/search/selection state. This delta nests the existing QueryState, BillResults and pagination in a results frame; currentBoard and the governed queries retain data/transport ownership. No request, receipt or paging algorithm moved into the view.

Passes only its already-current capability records as optional suggestions. Query scope, invalidation and unavailable handling remain in existing hooks; no new catalog, service, DTO or cross-client state is created.
Owns the existing saved/create dialog and tabs. It forwards current-record suggestions to the create form without changing lifecycle, receipt, draft, document or focus ownership.

Owns the existing native capability form and fields. It forwards optional suggestions only to creation identity fields; form parsing, mutation boundaries and arbitrary type/sector strings remain canonical. Saved Details still renders the authored variant.
Adds current verified client name to the existing Team dialog solely for owner-dialog context. All current-client failure gates, activity/overview composition and transport ownership are unchanged.

Owns the ordered-owner card list and local pointer/keyboard interaction. The canonical hook owns draft validation, source/version binding and writes; this component receives that editor and current team display roles, and contains no request or duplicate contract. It preserves empty positions and only an explicit reorder moves an owner. Its nested map is reviewed separately.

Renders one rank card, current person/unavailable identity, native member selection, rank badge and clear/reorder controls. All edits delegate to the canonical editor; no authorization or persistence lives in this rendering callback. Keeping the related card controls together avoids obscuring keyboard/drag parity across fragments.

Retains team membership lifecycle; adds a dedicated Owners entry and passes only verified current team roles and client display name. Its existing source/pending/unknown fences still block owner changes. The owner dialog/hook remain distinct cohesive owners.

Remains the single ordered-owner read/draft/versioned-write/read-back lifecycle owner. The added explicit local reorder preserves the captured base/source and pending/stale/uncertainty fences, clears no persisted data and sends no request. Existing save validation still rejects holes/duplicates; clearing a rank never promotes another owner.

Composes the canonical index queries, URL filters, profile catalog, attention and dialogs. Secondary tabs/filter disclosure are extracted to IndexNavigation, owner choices to IndexOwnerFilter. Customize only controls visibility of existing local layout editing; full catalog, current-read concealment, actor/session and objective focus ownership remain unchanged. See docs/visual-closeout-20261012/STRUCTURE-REVIEW.md. Done customizing explicitly returns focus to its trigger.

Owns one organization layout draft and its explicit save/conflict/reconciliation UI. An editing flag hides controls outside Customize; it does not duplicate layout state or bypass any availability/current catalog/write fence. Guidance now reflects explicit Save and is hidden when blocked; Done stays disabled while a changed or unresolved write exists.

Retains Portfolio index/card/chooser presentation and responsive rules. The added header owner filter and compact navigation/disclosure styling are scoped to the same index. No global shell tokens, mode navigation, backend state or unrelated domain rules are added.
